evidence: The scanning electron microscopy (SEM) images of blank (≈230 nm inner diameter) and 50 ALD MoSe xOy cycles coated TiO2 nanotube layers are shown in Figure 1. The energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDX) elemental mapping and line scan of the 50 cycles MoSe xOy-coated TiO2 nanotube layer taken from the interface of the bottom part of the TiO 2 nanotube layer and the under-lying Ti substrate is shown in Figures S1 and S2 (Supporting Information). X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) was used to analyze the compositional analyses of the MoSe xOy coatings. Ellipsometric measurement was used to determine the thickness of the coating. Photocurrent measurements were carried out in an aqueous electrolyte containing 0.1 m Na2SO4. The photocatalytic activity was evaluated based on the photocatalytic decomposition of MB solution with an initial concentration of 1 × 10−5 m. The absorbance of the MB solution was periodically measured with 10 min interval by a UV–visible spectrometer. Diffuse reflectance measurement was carried out to evaluate the optical bandgap.
